summary: Iteration 95 — Excel round-trip (components+tech-cards) + dealer-pricing comparison. Backend 13/13 new + 25/25 regression PASS. Frontend: both new flows fully verified end-to-end. Export downloads .xlsx with correct filename pattern; import dialog opens, runs dry-run on round-trip, shows DiffSection with +0/0/53 counters and Изменений нет, commit-btn correctly disabled. Dealer Comparison tab renders all 5 testids (page/search/only-overrides/csv/table), 82 rows shown, CSV download fires with filename dealer_prices_2026-05-16.csv, and a dealer override (99 999 zł vs base 19 880 zł) is rendered with red tinting per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: sauna_production_excel.diff_components: numeric comparison uses _norm_num(v or 0) which treats None and 0 as equal. Good — fixes the false-positive flagged in the iteration note.

import-commit upserts components by id first then by case-insensitive name — duplicate names with different ids will silently merge. Consider a warning in the dry-run diff when name-collision happens across ids.

GET /api/admin/dealers/comparison aggregates options from prices.options + prices.categories[].options into one list; if the same option id appears in both (theoretical) it would yield two rows. Worth de-duping by id.
Comparison endpoint loads ALL overrides (limit 20000); for very large dealer counts an indexed Mongo aggregation pipeline would scale better.

Frontend ImportExportButtons: dropping non-xlsx into the file input still calls /import-dry-run and surfaces a 400 — could short-circuit client-side by validating accept=.xlsx (currently the input has accept attribute but drag-drop bypass is still possible).
